manifest_row.title: Life in the shallows becomes a trap for baby sharks

screening.main_topic: Baby reef sharks’ tolerance of extreme nursery conditions and the threat climate change poses to their habitats and future populations.
screening.climate_relevance: The article explains that warming waters and declining oxygen may make shallow nursery habitats unsuitable, leaving young sharks with few safe alternatives and raising questions about whether they can adapt quickly enough.
screening.reason: Although the study focuses on shark physiology, climate change is a major part of the article’s framing and discussion of risks to shark populations, not merely a passing mention.
